q: 1. The minimum and maximum number of members in the user's committee should be ........
explain: As per the answer key, a user's committee has a minimum of 9 and a maximum of 15 members.

q: 2. The award of contract is given to those bidders whose
explain: Contracts are typically awarded to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, i.e., the bidder with the lowest bid amount.

q: 3. The authority to conduct the technical auditing in Nepal lies with ........
options: Office of Prime Minister and Council Of Ministers
explain: As per the answer key, the National Vigilance Center is the answer.

q: 4. Generally during the evaluation of consulting firms to award the contract, the weightage will be ........
explain: Consultants are usually evaluated on quality and cost, with the technical score weighted much higher (80:20). Option d has a misprint (800%) in the book.

q: 5. Who is the chairperson of Project Coordination Committee?
explain: The Project Coordination Committee at the district level is chaired by the Chairperson of the District Development Committee (DDC).

q: 6. The type of contract when payment shall be made for actual work done at site is ........
explain: In a unit rate contract, payment is made on the measured quantities of work actually done at the agreed unit rates.

q: 7. The penalty provision on any contract agreement is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the delay penalty (liquidated damage) is 0.05% of the contract price per day.

q: 8. The price adjustment clause is essential for contract having duration greater than ........ months.
explain: As per the answer key, the clause is essential for contracts longer than 12 months.

q: 9. Prequilification is not required for any types of firm if the costing to buy an equipment is
explain: Prequalification procedures are exempt for procurement works/goods below 20 million NRs thresholds.

q: 10. The minimum and maximum no. of members in the user's committee should be
explain: According to Nepal Public Procurement Regulations (PPR), a User Committee must consist of a minimum of 9 and maximum of 15 members.

q: 11. प्रत्येक बोलपत्र दाताले बढीमा कतिवटा बोलपत्र दाखिला गर्न सक्छ ?
explain: Under PPR provisions, a bidder can submit only one bid for the same procurement package.

q: 12. The maximum and minimum number of members in the user's committee should be
explain: As per Public Procurement rules, a user's committee should have a maximum of 15 and a minimum of 9 members.

q: 13. The employer's have right to ........
explain: The employer may accept or reject bids, within the procurement rules.

q: 14. The number of members in dispute resolution committee are
explain: A standard Dispute Resolution Board (DRB / Adjudication) usually consists of 1 or 3 neutral members.

q: 15. Who is the chairperson of project co ordination committee?
explain: As per the answer key, the chairperson of the DDC chairs the project coordination committee.

q: 16. The duration of notice for sealed quotation is ........ days.
explain: As per the answer key, the sealed quotation notice period is 15 days.

q: 17. The duration of notice for national competitive bidding in days ........
explain: National competitive bidding requires a 21-day notice period.

q: 18. The duration of notice for international competitive bidding in days ........
explain: International bidders need more time, so the notice period is 45 days.

q: 19. There is no fixation of qualification of contractor for execution of work up to ........
explain: As per the answer key, no contractor qualification is fixed for small works up to 20 million.

q: 20. Who is the Chairperson of House Rent Fixation Committee ?
explain: Government office house rent valuation and fixation committees are headed by the Chief District Officer (CDO).

q: 21. The contactor's pre qualification is required for ........
explain: Pre-qualification screens contractors for large, complex works. It is not needed for small works.

q: 22. The apex body in relation to the public procurement in Nepal is
explain: The Public Procurement Monitoring Office (PPMO) is the apex regulatory body overseeing public procurement in Nepal.

q: 23. The bid evaluation committee consists of ........ number of persons.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid evaluation committee has 4 members.

q: 24. Direct purchase for consulting services is limited to the amount ........
explain: As per the answer key, the limit is 5 lakh.

q: 25. In Nepal, public procurement act was effective from ........
explain: The Public Procurement Act came into effect in 2063 BS.

q: 26. Collusive practice" means
options: offering anything to influence the action of public official
arrangement between two or more parties to achieve an improper purpose including influencing improperly the action of another party
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Collusive practice refers to anti-competitive arrangements between bidders to fix artificial bid prices or manipulate outcomes.

q: 27. If the variation is 10-15% of original contact cost, then the approval of variation of cost is done by ........
explain: As per the answer key, the department head approves variations in this range.

q: 28. The purpose of bid evaluation is to determine
explain: Public procurement laws enforce selection based on the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bid.

q: 29. What is EPC contract?
explain: EPC stands for Engineering, Procurement, and Construction—a turn-key contracting model.

q: 30. The estimated cost of works must be quoted in the tender notice for works worth up to ........
explain: As per the answer key, the estimated cost must be stated in the notice for works up to 2 crore.

q: 31. Which of the following is done in procurement of consulting services?
explain: The answer key gives EOI. All four steps occur in consultant selection (EOI, short listing, RFP, evaluation), so this question is weak.

q: 32. As per the prevalling Public Procurement Acts & Regulations of Nepal, provision of price adjustments is normally to inculpated in civil works contract having project duration ?
explain: Price adjustment provisions are mandatorily included for civil construction contracts having execution periods exceeding 12 months.

q: 33. The number of categories of contractors in Nepal are ........
explain: Contractors in Nepal are classified into 4 classes (A, B, C and D).
